title: Quality management and supplier audits | Aquemi
meta: How our quality management system controls changes, data integrity, nonconformances, traceability, calibration and suppliers, and how to audit it before you order.
headline: Audit our quality system before you award
lead: Your lab results stay the release reference; any change to a qualified system goes through your change control. Here: our quality system, its records and how to audit it.

Calibration

Document control

Document register; client comment logs

blocks.h: How a defect is held and closed

items.d: Whoever finds it tags and segregates the item or stops work, raising an NCR. A failed test is logged and investigated, never resampled to pass.
Reject, rework or accept as is. Accepting as is, or an unapproved repair, needs your approval.
A rejected product-contact joint is cut out and remade to [PP joint repair rule], under a new number.
Repeat, systemic or client-reported: cause found, procedure, training or supplier changed.
Evidence after an agreed period that the action worked, signed before the CAPA closes.
Every NCR logged in your turnover package; one after shipment reaches you within [NCR notice after shipment, working days].

items.q: Can we audit you before we order?
items.a: Yes. Remotely, or on site at [shop location, city and province] with [on-site audit notice, working days] notice. Cost: [supplier audit before order, free or charged].

items.q: What is in the questionnaire pack?
items.a: Our questionnaire or yours, procedure list, certification status and organization chart. Aquemi-written specimen records: a nonconformance, its corrective and preventive action, and a change request. Onboarding papers and their status are on our buying page.

items.q: Will you sign our quality agreement?
items.a: [quality agreement mark-up turnaround, working days] for our mark-up, from receipt. Send it with your request for proposal. Changes to parts, materials or software you approved: notice per [change notification to clients: scope and notice].
[role that releases to ship, and its independence]. Nothing ships with an open nonconformance report (NCR) on a product-contact part unless you approved its disposition.

items.q: What should we ask any Purified Water supplier?
items.a: Five things make proposals comparable. The document index, with who writes and who signs each document. A factory acceptance test (FAT) that runs the system on water. The record kept for each product-contact joint. Access to audit the quality system before you order. A list of each data integrity requirement and the control that meets it.
